run_eval_simmc_agent: run the SIMMC agent evaluation script with a checkpoint and evaluation data path
evaluate_agent: evaluate a SIMMC agent model on a dataloader and compute loss, perplexity, BLEU, and action metrics
evaluate_response_generation: evaluate response generation quality using BLEU score against reference responses
evaluate_response_retrieval: evaluate retrieval performance by scoring candidate items against ground truth
evaluate_action_prediction: evaluate action prediction accuracy and attribute accuracy with confusion matrix
